metadata.question: Is the size of ozone hole (<220 Dobson units) over Antarctica between September 26 and 30, 2024 larger than that between August 26 and 30, 2024?

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Define Antarctica region (approximate polygon)
antartica = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[-180, -60], [-180, -90], [180, -90], [180, -60]]
])

# Date ranges
aug_start = '2024-08-26'
aug_end = '2024-08-30'
sep_start = '2024-09-26'
sep_end = '2024-09-30'

# 2. Data Acquisition
# OMI/Aura Ozone (O3) Total Column Daily L3 Global 0.25deg x 0.25deg
collection_aug = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OMI/DATA_MERRA2/TO3')
    .filterDate(aug_start, aug_end)
    .filterBounds(antartica)
    .select('ColumnAmountO3')  # Ozone total column in Dobson Units

collection_sep = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OMI/DATA_MERRA2/TO3')
    .filterDate(sep_start, sep_end)
    .filterBounds(antartica)
    .select('ColumnAmountO3')

# Check collection sizes
aug_size = collection_aug.size().getInfo()
sep_size = collection_sep.size().getInfo()

print(f"August 26-30, 2024 Images: {aug_size}")
print(f"September 26-30, 2024 Images: {sep_size}")

# If no data, try alternative collection
if aug_size == 0 or sep_size == 0:
    # Try alternative: OMI/Aura Ozone (O3) Total Column Daily L3
    collection_aug = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OMI/DATA_MERRA2/TO3')
        .filterDate(aug_start, aug_end)
        .filterBounds(antartica)
        .select('ColumnAmountO3')
    
    collection_sep = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OMI/DATA_MERRA2/TO3')
        .filterDate(sep_start, sep_end)
        .filterBounds(antartica)
        .select('ColumnAmountO3')
    
    aug_size = collection_aug.size().getInfo()
    sep_size = collection_sep.size().getInfo()
    print(f"After fallback - August: {aug_size}, September: {sep_size}")

if aug_size == 0 or sep_size == 0:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing - Calculate mean ozone for each period
    aug_mean = collection_aug.mean()
    sep_mean = collection_sep.mean()
    
    # Create ozone hole mask (<220 Dobson units)
    aug_hole = aug_mean.lt(220)  # Pixels with ozone < 220 DU
    sep_hole = sep_mean.lt(220)
    
    # Calculate area of ozone hole (in km²)
    # Use pixel area at native resolution (0.25 deg)
    pixel_area = ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(1e6)  # Convert m² to km²
    
    aug_area_img = aug_hole.multiply(pixel_area)
    sep_area_img = sep_hole.multiply(pixel_area)
    
    # Calculate total area
    aug_area = aug_area_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=antartica,
        scale=25000,  # 25km scale for efficiency
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('ColumnAmountO3').getInfo()
    
    sep_area = sep_area_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=antartica,
        scale=25000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('ColumnAmountO3').getInfo()
    
    # Also get pixel counts for validation
    aug_count = aug_hole.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=antartica,
        scale=25000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('ColumnAmountO3').getInfo()
    
    sep_count = sep_hole.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=antartica,
        scale=25000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('ColumnAmountO3').getInfo()
    
    print(f"August ozone hole area: {aug_area:.0f} km² (Pixels: {aug_count})")
    print(f"September ozone hole area: {sep_area:.0f} km² (Pixels: {sep_count})")
    
    # 4. Validation & Final Answer
    # Check for no valid pixels
    if aug_count == 0 or sep_count == 0:
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    # Check for invalid results (NaN, None, or unrealistic values)
    elif (aug_area is None or sep_area is None or 
          aug_area != aug_area or sep_area != sep_area or  # Check for NaN
          aug_area < 0 or sep_area < 0 or
          aug_area > 30e6 or sep_area > 30e6):  # Antarctica area ~14 million km²
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        # Compare areas
        if sep_area > aug_area:
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
